Objectives
Basic concept of echogenicity.
Identify the four chambers of the heart
Identify the tricuspid and bicuspid (mitral) valves.
Identify the interventricular and interatrial septa.

Ultrasound or ultrasonography
It is a non-invasive medical imaging technique that uses high-frequency sound waves to generate real-time images of our internal body structures.

What is Echogenicity
The brightness of an image caused by the reflection of the sound waves. It is influenced by the density of an organ/tissue
Stone
Ligaments 
Tendons
Bone

What is echocardiography? 
It is an ultrasound of the heart.
Echocardiography is a  medical imaging technique that uses high-frequency sound waves (ultrasound) to create detailed images of the heart's structure and function.
Echocardiography

Methods or approaches of 
echocardiograpy
There are several approaches or types of echocardiography.
Transthoracic Echocardiography (TTE):
 This is one of the most common 
types
 of echocardiography, involving the placement of a transducer on the chest to obtain images of the heart through the chest wall.
